ambient_events: A stone kicked into Pit Nine falls a long time and never lands, or lands too far to hear.
Cold, still air breathes up out of Pit Nine, smelling of deep earth and something metallic.
description: A collapsed pit, numbered nine by someone who counted eight others just like it, that goes down into the dark further than a dropped stone will report back on. Its rim is the western edge of the walkable wastes.
name: Pit Nine
